description: Deer management data including CWD zones, DMP areas, antler restrictions, and Earn-A-Buck information

cwd_management_area.name: Chronic Wasting Disease Management Area (CWDMA)
cwd_management_area.description: Area where CWD surveillance and management activities occur
cwd_management_area.surveillance_approach: Risk-based sampling from hunter harvest, DMP operations, and road-killed deer
cwd_management_area.confidence_level: 95% confidence CWD does not exist at >5% prevalence

cwd_carcass_transport_restrictions.description: Rules for transporting deer from CWD zones

whole_carcass.restriction: Cannot be transported out of CWDMA
whole_carcass.exception: Can transport to approved processor or taxidermist

requirements: Deer must be checked in first
Deer must be checked in first

deer_management_permit_dmp.name: Deer Management Permit (DMP)
deer_management_permit_dmp.purpose: Help landowners and farmers resolve legitimate crop damage
deer_management_permit_dmp.antlerless_requirement: All deer taken on DMPs must be antlerless
deer_management_permit_dmp.antlered_exception: Antlered deer may be issued for severe antler-rub damage to nursery or orchard stock (DNR determines quantity)
deer_management_permit_dmp.quota_basis: Case-by-case determination based on damage assessment
deer_management_permit_dmp.contact_method: Contact county WHS DMP coordinator during business hours
deer_management_permit_dmp.notes: Specific antlerless quotas vary by county and individual permit assessment

antler_point_restrictions.description: Statewide antler point requirements for harvested deer
antler_point_restrictions.restriction: One antlered deer per license year must have at least 3 points on one antler (3-point minimum)
antler_point_restrictions.exception: May harvest one antlered deer without meeting 3-point requirement
antler_point_restrictions.notes: Specific county variations exist - check current regulations

earn_a_buck_program.name: Earn-A-Buck Program
earn_a_buck_program.status: Program exists but specific 2025-2026 county designations require verification
earn_a_buck_program.general_concept: Hunters must harvest antlerless deer before antlered deer in designated areas
earn_a_buck_program.notes: Check current Maryland hunting guide for county-specific Earn-A-Buck designations

sika_deer_hunting.name: Sika Deer Hunting
sika_deer_hunting.description: Asian sika deer found on Eastern Shore properties
sika_deer_hunting.notes: Populations found in coastal marshes alongside white-tailed deer

white_tailed_deer_seasons.harvest_reports_available: Annual Big Game Reports available from Maryland DNR
